description: This Java class 'CoreDataTuner' modifies Liquibase database change logs by reordering change sets, removing certain change sets, and updating the admin user credentials. It extends an abstract class 'AbstractSnapshotTuner' and is used for managing Liquibase snapshots in the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: CoreDataTuner
classes.description: A class for modifying Liquibase change logs by reordering, filtering, and updating change sets for OpenMRS database snapshots.

methods.name: updateChangeLog
methods.description: Main method that updates the given Liquibase changelog document by detaching and caching change sets, adding them in a new order, and updating the admin user credentials.

methods.name: detachAndCacheChangeSets
methods.description: Removes change sets related to certain tables from the document and caches them for reordering.

methods.name: addChangeSets
methods.description: Reinserts cached change sets into the document in a specific order, prioritizing certain tables.

methods.name: updateAdminUser
methods.description: Updates the 'admin' user's username and password in the change log.

methods.name: getDatabaseChangeLogElement
methods.description: Retrieves the root 'databaseChangeLog' element from the Document.

methods.name: getFirstTableNames
methods.description: Returns the list of table names that should be processed first.

methods.name: getChangeSetsByTableName
methods.description: Returns the map of table names to their corresponding change set nodes.

methods.name: getTableNames
methods.description: Returns the list of table names encountered during processing.
